t: A $(thing)Thermopneumatic Processing Plant/$ uses $(l:base_concepts/pressure)pressure/$ and/or $(l:base_concepts/heat)heat/$ to process materials. It has several uses:$(li)100mB $(thing)LPG/$ and 1 piece of $(item)Coal/$ makes 1000mB of $(l:components/plastic)Plastic/$. This requires heat, but no pressure.$(li)1000mB of $(thing)Diesel/$ and 1 piece of $(item)Redstone Dust/$ makes 1000mB of $(l:components/lubricant)Lubricant/$. Again, this requires heat, but no pressure.

$(thing)热气动加工机/$使用$(l:base_concepts/pressure)压力/$和/或$(l:base_concepts/heat)热量/$来处理材料。它有多种用途：$(li)100mB 的$(thing)液化石油气/$和 1 个$(item)煤炭/$可制成 1000mB 的$(l:components/plastic)塑料/$。这需要热量，但不需要压力。$(li)1000mB 的$(thing)柴油/$和 1 个$(item)红石粉/$可制成 1000mB 的$(l:components/lubricant)润滑油/$。同样，这需要热量，但不需要压力。

$(li)The $(item)Thermopneumatic Processing Plant/$ can be used to crack heavier fuels produced by a $(l:manufacturing/refinery)Refinery/$ into lighter fuels at an 80% return rate:$(li)Diesel -> Kerosene$(li)Kerosene -> Gasoline$(li)Gasoline -> LPG$(p)This requires both heat and pressure.
$(li)$(item)热气动加工机/$可用于将由$(l:manufacturing/refinery)精炼厂/$产出的较重燃料裂化为较轻燃料，返还率为 80%：$(li)柴油 -> 煤油$(li)煤油 -> 汽油$(li)汽油 -> 液化石油气$(p)这需要同时提供热量和压力。

The $(thing)Thermopneumatic Processing Plant/$ has $(l:https://minecraft.curseforge.com/projects/crafttweaker)CraftTweaker/$ support: recipes can be added and removed. Follow the link below for more information.
$(thing)热气动加工机/$支持$(l:https://minecraft.curseforge.com/projects/crafttweaker)CraftTweaker/$：可添加和移除配方。点击下方链接了解更多信息。
